```plato
    // The point of the polyline (or closed ring, when `closed`) nearest to `point`:
    // the nearest of the per-edge nearest points.
    ClosestPointOnChain(points: Array<Point2D>, closed: Boolean, point: Point2D): Point2D
    {
        var candidates = (closed ? points.Count : points.Count - 1)
            .MapRange(i => ClosestPointOnSegment(points[i], points.AtModulo(i + 1), point));
        return candidates.Reduce(candidates.First, (best, c) =>
            c.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared < best.Between(point).MagnitudeSquared ? c : best);
    }
```
